Physical Activity
Physical activity is the most variable component of energy 
expenditure (see Chapter 2). Increases in energy expenditure 
through exercise and other forms of physical activity are 
important components of interventions for weight loss and its 
maintenance. By increasing LBM in proportion to fat, physical 
activity helps to balance the loss of LBM and reduction of 
RMR that inevitably accompany intentional weight reduction.
